conceptual_review.notes: The chapter distinguishes Unit of Work from database transaction, repository, identity map, ORM session, Service Layer operation, long conversation, local outbox, distributed transaction, and saga while defining their composition.

practitioner_review.notes: Guidance covers scope, state lifecycle, identity, tracking strategies, snapshots, dependency ordering, batching, flush/commit/rollback, versions/locks, repositories, generated values/triggers, cascades, outbox, bulk/native writes, nesting, conversation state, observability, and real integration/fault tests.

pedagogical_review.notes: Objectives align with identity/change-set/version notation, a runnable finite UoW, ten distinct examples, and five complete exercises spanning trace/counterexample, lifecycle specification, dependency derivation, remediation, and high-stakes transfer.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external academic or practitioner review is claimed.
